body.label: Trigger
body.html: An ally adjacent to another ally is targeted by an Action.

body.label: Effect
body.html: The target gains +1 Defense. One adjacent ally may also shift 1 unit to remain adjacent after the Action resolves.

surges.html: One affected ally may move 1 unit after the triggering effect resolves.
A second eligible ally within 2 units receives one non-damage benefit of this Reaction.
